content:
Pagination অনেক QA checklist-এ "page 1 আসল, page 2 আসল — done" level-এ থেমে যায়। কিন্তু Production-এ pagination bug user-কে blank page, duplicate item, বা missing record দেখায় — আর root cause খুঁজতে গেলে boundary logic, sort/filter combination, বা unstable dataset-এর সমস্যা বের হয়।

Pagination শুধু UI button নয় — backend-এ offset calculation, total count query, cursor token management — সব মিলিয়ে একটি system। Offset-based pagination (page + pageSize) এবং cursor-based pagination (after/before token) — দুটো pattern-ই আলাদা test approach দরকার। Real API-তে pagination প্রায় সবসময় filter ও sort-এর সাথে combine হয় — isolated test half coverage।

নিচে Pagination API-এর জন্য একটি সম্পূর্ণ, production-ready test suite দেওয়া হলো। সব test case text format-এ — code block ছাড়াই, professional QA documentation style-এ।

---

Pagination API বুঝে নেওয়া — Test শুরু করার আগে

বেশিরভাগ REST API-তে pagination দুইভাবে implement হয়:

Offset-Based Pagination

page এবং pageSize parameter — page 1 = record 1–10, page 2 = record 11–20। Simple, কিন্তু large offset-এ performance degrade হয় (OFFSET 100000 slow)।

Cursor-Based Pagination

after বা cursor token — last seen item-এর ID/timestamp দিয়ে next batch fetch। Real-time feed, infinite scroll-এ standard। Sort change করলে cursor invalid হয় — documented behavior verify করুন।

Metadata Field অর্থ Verify করুন
totalমোট record countAll pages sum == total
totalPagesceil(total / pageSize)Math correct, partial last page
pageCurrent page numberRequest-এর সাথে match
pageSizePer page item countActual array length <= pageSize
hasNext / hasPreviousNavigation hintFirst/last page-এ correct boolean
---

Basic Positive Test Cases

TC-PAGE-001: First Page — Default Page Size

Endpoint: GET /api/products?page=1&pageSize=10

Expected Result: Status 200 OK। প্রথম 10টি record return। Metadata: page=1, pageSize=10, total=150 (example), totalPages=15। Response array length = 10 (full page)।

TC-PAGE-002: Second Page

Query: page=2&pageSize=10

Expected Result: Record 11–20 return। Page 1-এর সাথে কোনো ID overlap হবে না। Sequential order maintain (default sort অনুযায়ী)।

TC-PAGE-003: Last Page — Full

Query: page=15&pageSize=10 (total=150)

Expected Result: Record 141–150 return — exactly 10 item। hasNext=false (if supported)।

TC-PAGE-004: Last Page — Partial Data

Scenario: total=145, pageSize=10, page=15

Expected Result: Exactly 5 record return — record 141–145। Empty array acceptable নয়। totalPages=15 correctly calculated (ceil(145/10))।

TC-PAGE-005: Default Pagination Parameters

Query: No page/pageSize parameter

Expected Result: Documented default apply — সাধারণত page=1, pageSize=20। Response metadata-তে applied values indicate।

TC-PAGE-006: Single Record Dataset

Scenario: Filter apply করে exactly 1 record match

Expected Result: page=1-এ 1 item, total=1, totalPages=1। page=2 request করলে empty array — 404 নয়।

TC-PAGE-007: Empty Dataset

Scenario: Filter result zero record

Expected Result: 200 OK, empty array, total=0, totalPages=0 (or 1 — documented)। Error throw হবে না।

---

Boundary Value Test Cases

TC-PAGE-008: Page Beyond Last Page

Query: page=999&pageSize=10 (total=150, max page=15)

Expected Result: 200 OK, empty array, page=999, total=150 unchanged। 404 বা 500 acceptable নয় — out-of-range page error নয়, empty result।

TC-PAGE-009: Page Number Zero

Query: page=0&pageSize=10

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, "Page number must be greater than 0." Silent wrap to last page acceptable নয়।

TC-PAGE-010: Negative Page Number

Query: page=-1&pageSize=10

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — negative offset calculation server crash করবে না।

TC-PAGE-011: Page Size Zero

Query: pageSize=0

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, "Page size must be at least 1." Division by zero totalPages calculation-এ crash prevent।

TC-PAGE-012: Page Size One — Minimum

Query: pageSize=1

Expected Result: Exactly 1 record per page। totalPages == total count। Navigation many pages — performance acceptable।

TC-PAGE-013: Very Large Page Size

Query: pageSize=10000

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request (max enforced) অথবা capped at max allowed (e.g., 100) — documented behavior। Full table dump memory exhaustion prevent।

TC-PAGE-014: Non-Numeric Page Parameter

Query: page=abc&pageSize=10

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — type coercion bug prevent (page="abc" silently treated as 0)।

TC-PAGE-015: Decimal Page Number

Query: page=2.5&pageSize=10

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request অথবা truncate to 2 — documented, consistent behavior।

TC-PAGE-016: Maximum Allowed Page Size

Query: pageSize=100 (if max=100)

Expected Result: 200 OK, up to 100 records return। Boundary exact — 101 request rejected।

---

Data Integrity Test Cases

Pagination-এর core promise — প্রতিটি record exactly once appear, none missing, none duplicated।

TC-PAGE-017: No Duplicate Records Across Pages

Steps: All pages fetch করে combined list তৈরি করুন।

Expected Result: Unique ID count == total item count। Zero duplicate ID — JOIN query bug বা unstable sort indicator।

TC-PAGE-018: No Missing Records

Steps: Unfiltered total count note করুন। All pages fetch করে item count sum compare।

Expected Result: Sum == total। Gap (missing ID) হলে offset calculation বা sort instability bug।

TC-PAGE-019: Total Count Consistency

Steps: page=1 metadata total vs all pages item sum compare।

Expected Result: Metadata total == actual sum। Inflated total — empty pages at end। Deflated total — data truncated silently।

TC-PAGE-020: totalPages Calculation

Scenario: total=145, pageSize=10

Expected Result: totalPages=15 (ceil(145/10))। Off-by-one: totalPages=14 হলে last 5 record inaccessible।

TC-PAGE-021: Page Boundary Continuity

Steps: Page 1 last item এবং Page 2 first item compare (default sort-এ)।

Expected Result: Sequential order maintained — gap বা overlap নয়। Sort applied থাকলে sort order cross-page consistent।

---

Pagination + Sort Combined Tests

TC-PAGE-022: Sort + Pagination — Price Ascending

Query: sort=price&order=asc&page=2&pageSize=5

Expected Result: Globally 6th–10th cheapest item। Page 1 last price <= Page 2 first price। Full dataset sorted order-এ page 2 segment correct।

TC-PAGE-023: Sort + Pagination — All Pages Global Order

Steps: sort=createdAt&order=desc, all pages fetch, combined list verify globally descending।

Expected Result: Entire combined list sorted — page boundary-তে order break নয়।

TC-PAGE-024: Sort Change Resets Page Context

Scenario: User page 5-এ, sort direction change করে desc-এ।

Expected Result: Page 1-এ reset — page 5 desc order-এ meaningless segment দেখাবে না। API level-এ sort change + high page number gracefully handle।

---

Pagination + Filter Combined Tests

TC-PAGE-025: Filter + Pagination — Category

Query: category=electronics&page=2&pageSize=10

Expected Result: Page 2 of electronics only — non-electronics item zero across all pages। Total count filtered count (electronics only)।

TC-PAGE-026: Filter Changes Total Pages

Steps: No filter totalPages vs category=electronics totalPages compare।

Expected Result: Filtered totalPages <= unfiltered। Filter apply-এ pagination metadata update।

TC-PAGE-027: Page Beyond Filtered Total

Query: category=rare&page=50&pageSize=10 (filtered total=3)

Expected Result: 200 OK, empty array — filtered context-এ out-of-range handle।

---

Cursor-Based Pagination Tests

TC-PAGE-028: First Page — Cursor Response

Endpoint: GET /api/products?limit=10

Expected Result: 10 item + nextCursor (or hasNext=true)। First page-এ previousCursor null/absent।

TC-PAGE-029: Next Page via Cursor

Query: after={nextCursorFromPage1}&limit=10

Expected Result: Next 10 item — Page 1 item-এর সাথে overlap নয়। Cursor points to correct position।

TC-PAGE-030: Last Page — No Next Cursor

Expected Result: hasNext=false, nextCursor null/absent। Remaining item < limit হলে partial page return — empty acceptable নয় যদি data থাকে।

TC-PAGE-031: Invalid / Expired Cursor

Query: after=invalidtoken123

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request with clear message — 500 বা random data acceptable নয়।

TC-PAGE-032: Cursor Invalid After Sort Change

Steps: Cursor obtain করুন sort=price asc-এ, sort=price desc-এ same cursor use করুন।

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — cursor sort context-এ bound। Wrong order data return acceptable নয়।

TC-PAGE-033: Bidirectional Cursor — Previous Page

Query: before={cursor}&limit=10

Expected Result: Previous 10 item reverse chronological। Forward then backward navigation original position-এ return।

---

Dynamic Data & Concurrency Tests

TC-PAGE-034: New Record Insert During Pagination

Scenario: Page 1 fetch, backend-এ new record insert (matching sort/filter), Page 2 fetch।

Expected Result: Eventual consistency documented — duplicate or skip possible in real-time system। Strong consistency claim থাকলে verify no skip/duplicate।

TC-PAGE-035: Record Delete During Pagination

Scenario: Page 1 fetch, record delete, Page 2 fetch।

Expected Result: Documented behavior — item shift causing duplicate/skip acknowledge in spec।

TC-PAGE-036: Concurrent Page Requests

Steps: page=1, page=2, page=3 simultaneously request (same user)।

Expected Result: প্রতিটি response correct, independent — cross-contamination নয়। Consistent snapshot (same sort/filter)।

---

UI & API Consistency Tests

TC-PAGE-037: Page Number Display Matches API

Steps: UI-তে "Page 3" click করুন, Network tab inspect।

Expected Result: API call page=3। UI current page indicator match।

TC-PAGE-038: Next / Previous Button State

Expected Result: Page 1-এ Previous disabled। Last page-এ Next disabled। Middle page-এ both enabled। Disabled button click করলে API call নয়।

TC-PAGE-039: Page Size Selector

Steps: UI-তে pageSize 10 → 25 change করুন।

Expected Result: API call pageSize=25, page=1 reset। Item count per page update। totalPages recalculate।

TC-PAGE-040: Jump to Last Page

Steps: UI "Last Page" button click।

Expected Result: API call page=totalPages। Partial last page correctly display — not empty if data exists।

TC-PAGE-041: Pagination URL Persistence

Steps: Page 3 navigate, URL refresh।

Expected Result: page=3 URL-এ persist, same data reload। Shareable paginated URL কাজ করে।

TC-PAGE-042: Empty State UI

Scenario: Filter result zero, page=1

Expected Result: "No results" message — blank table without explanation acceptable নয়। Pagination controls hidden or disabled appropriately।

---

Performance & Scalability Tests

TC-PAGE-043: First Page Response Time

Query: page=1&pageSize=20

Expected Result: Response < 200ms (SLA adjust)। Index-backed query — full scan avoid।

TC-PAGE-044: Deep Offset Performance

Query: page=5000&pageSize=10 (offset=49990)

Expected Result: Acceptable response time — extreme slow query-তে timeout gracefully। Cursor-based alternative documented for deep pagination।

TC-PAGE-045: Large Page Size Performance

Query: pageSize=100 (max allowed)

Expected Result: Response within SLA। Payload size reasonable — unnecessary field exclude (projection)।

TC-PAGE-046: Concurrent Pagination Load

Steps: 50 user different page number-এ simultaneously request।

Expected Result: Server stable, all correct page data — no cross-user data leak।

---

Security Test Cases

TC-PAGE-047: Pagination Parameter Injection

Query: page=1; DROP TABLE products--&pageSize=10

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — injection execute নয়। Parameterized query verify।

TC-PAGE-048: Unauthorized Page Access

Scenario: Admin-only data paginated — regular user page=1 request।

Expected Result: 403 Forbidden — high page number দিয়ে bypass attempt block।

TC-PAGE-049: Cross-Tenant Pagination

Scenario: Tenant A user Tenant B data page access attempt (implicit filter bypass)।

Expected Result: Server-side tenant filter enforce — other tenant data paginate হলেও leak নয়।

---

Test Automation Strategy

  • Full Pagination Walk: Script all pages fetch → duplicate ID check → sum vs total assert — one command regression।
  • Boundary Generator: total=145, pageSize=10 → programmatically verify page 15 has 5 items।
  • Sort + Page Cross-Assert: Combined list globally sorted verify — pagination sort bug automated catch।
  • Metadata Math: totalPages = ceil(total/pageSize) automated assert every response।
  • Performance Baseline: page=1 vs page=5000 response time compare — deep offset regression detect।

Pro Tip:

Pagination test suite-এ TC-PAGE-004 (partial last page), TC-PAGE-017 (no duplicates), এবং TC-PAGE-018 (no missing records) — এ তিনটোকে mandatory regression-এ রাখুন। Production bug-এর majority "last page empty" এবং "duplicate across pages" — isolated page 1/2 test pass থেকে।

---

Bug Report Template — Pagination Issues

  • Exact API URL with page, pageSize, sort, filter parameters
  • Expected: page X item count, ID range, metadata total/totalPages
  • Actual: wrong count, duplicate IDs, missing IDs
  • All pages combined unique ID list (if duplicate/missing bug)
  • total vs sum of page counts mismatch evidence
  • UI screenshot + Network tab response metadata
---

পরিশেষে

Pagination Testing "page 1 works" level-এ থামলে Production-এ data integrity bug inevitable। সবচেয়ে critical তিনটি area:

  1. Partial last page — empty last page when data exists সবচেয়ে common complaint
  2. Duplicate & missing records — full pagination walk catch করে
  3. Sort/Filter + Pagination combo — isolated pagination test insufficient

এই 49টি test case offset-based, cursor-based, boundary, integrity, UI, performance, security — সব dimension cover করে। Release-এর আগে minimum TC-PAGE-001–004, TC-PAGE-017–019, এবং TC-PAGE-022 mandatory regression suite-এ রাখুন।

Tags: #PaginationTesting #APITesting #BoundaryValue #DataIntegrity #CursorPagination #OffsetPagination #QA #SQA
